        self._initialize_employee_defaults()
    
    def calculate_salary(self) -> float:
        return self.base_salary + (self.years_of_service * 1000)

        print(f"Pay slip for {self.name}: ${self.calculate_salary()}")
    
    def calculate_performance_bonus(self) -> float:
        base_bonus = self.base_salary * 0.12
        rating_multiplier = self.performance_rating / 5.0
        service_multiplier = min(self.years_of_service * 0.02, 0.15)
        return base_bonus * rating_multiplier * (1.0 + service_multiplier)
    
    def calculate_overtime_compensation(self) -> float:
        if self.overtime_hours > 0:
            hourly_rate = self.base_salary / (52 * 40)
            return self.overtime_hours * hourly_rate * 1.5
        return 0.0
    
    def calculate_total_compensation(self) -> float:
        return (self.calculate_salary() + 
                self.calculate_performance_bonus() + 
                self.calculate_overtime_compensation())
    
    def calculate_federal_tax(self, gross_pay: float) -> float:
        if gross_pay <= 4000:
            return gross_pay * 0.18
        elif gross_pay <= 8000:
            return gross_pay * 0.22
        else:
            return gross_pay * 0.28
    
    def calculate_state_tax(self, gross_pay: float) -> float:
        return gross_pay * 0.085
    
    def calculate_social_security_tax(self, gross_pay: float) -> float:
        return min(gross_pay * 0.062, 8853.60)
    
    def generate_compensation_breakdown(self) -> str:
        salary = self.calculate_salary()
        bonus = self.calculate_performance_bonus()
        overtime = self.calculate_overtime_compensation()
        gross = salary + bonus + overtime
        federal_tax = self.calculate_federal_tax(gross)
        state_tax = self.calculate_state_tax(gross)
        ss_tax = self.calculate_social_security_tax(gross)
        total_tax = federal_tax + state_tax + ss_tax
        net_pay = gross - total_tax
        
        breakdown = []
        breakdown.append("=== COMPENSATION BREAKDOWN ===")

        breakdown.append(f"Overtime Pay: ${overtime:.2f}")
        breakdown.append(f"Gross Pay: ${gross:.2f}")
        breakdown.append(f"Federal Tax: ${federal_tax:.2f}")
        breakdown.append(f"State Tax: ${state_tax:.2f}")
        breakdown.append(f"Social Security: ${ss_tax:.2f}")
        breakdown.append(f"Net Pay: ${net_pay:.2f}")
        return "\n".join(breakdown)
    
    def process_monthly_payroll(self):
        gross_pay = self.calculate_total_compensation()
        total_tax = (self.calculate_federal_tax(gross_pay) +

                    self.calculate_social_security_tax(gross_pay))
        net_pay = gross_pay - total_tax
        
        breakdown = self.generate_compensation_breakdown()
        print(breakdown)
        
        self.payroll_system.save_payroll_record(self, gross_pay, net_pay)
        
        email_body = self._create_payroll_notification_email(breakdown)
        self.email_service.send_email(self.email, f"Monthly Payroll - {self.name}", email_body)
        
        self.compliance_logger.log_event("PAYROLL_PROCESSED", 
                                        f"Monthly payroll processed for employee: {self.employee_id}")
    
    def _create_payroll_notification_email(self, breakdown: str) -> str:
        return (f"Dear {self.name},\n\n"
                f"Your monthly payroll has been processed.\n\n"
                f"{breakdown}\n\n"
                f"Best regards,\nPayroll Department")
    
    def request_vacation_days(self, days: int) -> bool:
        if self.used_vacation_days + days <= self.vacation_days:
            self.used_vacation_days += days
            
            self.hr_database.save_vacation_request(self.employee_id, days, True)
            
            manager_email = self._create_manager_notification_email(days)
            self.email_service.send_email(f"{self.manager}@company.com", 
                                        f"Vacation Request - {self.name}", manager_email)
            
            self._log_vacation_activity(days, "APPROVED")
            return True
        else:
            self._log_vacation_activity(days, "DENIED")
            return False
    
    def _create_manager_notification_email(self, days: int) -> str:
        remaining_days = self.vacation_days - self.used_vacation_days
        return (f"Manager Notification:\n\n"
                f"Employee {self.name} ({self.employee_id}) has requested {days} vacation days.\n"
                f"Remaining balance: {remaining_days} days.\n"
                f"Department: {self.department}")
    
    def _log_vacation_activity(self, days: int, status: str):
        log_message = f"Vacation request - Employee: {self.employee_id}, Days: {days}, Status: {status}"
        self.compliance_logger.log_event("VACATION_REQUEST", log_message)
    
    def conduct_annual_performance_review(self):
        review_report = self._generate_performance_review_report()

        self.hr_database.update_employee_record(self.employee_id, "performance_rating",

        review_email = self._create_performance_review_email(review_report)

        self.compliance_logger.log_event("PERFORMANCE_REVIEW",

        report.append(f"Certifications: {len(self.skill_certifications)}")
        
        if self.performance_rating >= 4.5:

        elif self.performance_rating < 2.5:
            report.append("Recommendation: Performance improvement plan required")
        
        return "\n".join(report)
    
    def _create_performance_review_email(self, report: str) -> str:
        return (f"Dear {self.name},\n\n"
                f"Your annual performance review has been completed.\n\n"
                f"{report}\n\n"
                f"Please schedule a meeting to discuss.\n\n"
                f"HR Department")
    
    def update_rating_with_notifications(self, new_rating: float):
        old_rating = self.performance_rating
        self.performance_rating = new_rating
        
        self.hr_database.update_employee_record(self.employee_id, "performance_rating",

        if abs(new_rating - old_rating) >= 1.0:

            self.email_service.send_email("hr@company.com",

        self._log_performance_change(old_rating, new_rating)
    
    def _create_rating_change_alert(self, old_rating: float, new_rating: float) -> str:

        self.compliance_logger.log_event("CERTIFICATION_ADDED",

    def _generate_unique_employee_id(self) -> str:

        self.personal_info["emergency_contact"] = ""

        self.personal_info["tax_filing_status"] = "single"
    
    def update_personal_information(self, field: str, value: str):
